bootstrap.title: Welcome to hullbay
bootstrap.description: No accounts exist yet. Create the administrator account (owner) that will manage the infrastructure. You will then be able to delegate limited access to an employee and enable two-factor authentication.

mfa.instruction: Enter the code from your authenticator app.

mfaModal.title: Enable MFA
mfaModal.description: To secure your account, enable two-factor authentication. Scan this QR code with your authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Authy, etc.) and then enter the code.
mfaModal.manualEntryHint: Copy this secret into your app if you can't scan.

deleteConfirm.title: Delete project?
deleteConfirm.description: "{{name}}" and all its nodes/links will be removed from the desired state. Docker resources already deployed must be destroyed separately from the canvas.

empty.title: No projects
empty.description: Create a project, then design its architecture on the canvas (containers, networks, volumes, gateways).

editModal.title: Rename project
editModal.slugHint: The technical slug (Docker resource prefix) cannot be changed.

auditLog.title: Audit log
auditLog.subtitle: Track sensitive actions (deployments, destructions, accounts, servers).
auditLog.emptyDescription: Sensitive actions will appear here once performed.

drawer.title: Event details
drawer.selectPrompt: Select an event to view details.

servers.title: Servers

quorum.title: Quorum (HA control plane)
quorum.description: {{reachable}}/{{total}} managers reachable. Recommended: odd number (3 tolerates 1 failure, 5 tolerates 2).

servers.empty: No servers. The first one added becomes the cluster manager.

deleteConfirm.title: Remove this registry?
deleteConfirm.description: Credentials for "{{registry}}" will be deleted. Private images from this registry can no longer be pulled during deployment.

empty.title: No registry
empty.description: Add Docker Hub, GHCR, or a private registry to deploy private images.

form.title: Add / update a registry
form.registryHint: Docker Hub = docker.io · GitHub = ghcr.io · or your private registry host.

deleteConfirm.title: Delete this secret?
deleteConfirm.description: "{{name}}" will be deleted. Any service still referencing it will fail on the next deployment.

empty.title: No secrets
empty.description: Create a secret and reference it by name in a container (mounted in /run/secrets).

setupDomain.title: Configure your domain
setupDomain.description: Enter the public domain you want to use to access your hullbay instance.
setupDomain.successMessage: Domain ready to be sent to the backend.

users.pageSubtitle: Delegate limited access (operator/viewer) to an employee.

deleteConfirm.title: Delete this account?
deleteConfirm.description: "{{email}}" will immediately lose access to the console.

empty.title: No other accounts
empty.description: Create an operator (can deploy) or a viewer (read-only) to delegate.

createModal.title: New user
createModal.passwordHint: The user can change it in Settings and enable MFA.
createModal.roleHint: Promotion to owner is done afterwards, explicitly from the list.
